facts.fact: Adam 与精灵 Dautre 的秘密会议地点是历史悠久的 Mayan 电影院，坐两班巴士（two buses）加一小段步行可达。
facts.anchor: Still, it was only two buses and a short walk to the Mayan, the historic movie theater where he and Dautre held their secret meetings.

facts.fact: Adam 询问是否还有别人死去，Dautre 回答没有——众人非常幸运有 Adam 在场介入。
facts.anchor: No. They were very fortunate that you were there to intervene.

facts.fact: Dautre 解释被捕获的 boggins 最终只是溶解消失——工作理论是它们无法存在于凡间或灵界。
facts.anchor: They simply dissolved. The working theory is that they cannot exist in the mortal or spirit realms.

facts.fact: Dautre 推测精灵们讳言 Between 是因为它是一座地狱——一座精灵地狱（an elven hell）。
facts.anchor: Though I suspect it is because it is a hell, an elven hell.

facts.fact: 老国王（Silver 的父亲）当年威胁要毁灭世界、消灭人类，被迫由他的独子开枪将他击毙。
facts.anchor: When the old king threatened to destroy the world, to wipe out humanity, his only son had been forced to gun him down.

facts.fact: Knight of Swords 当年把咒语交给 Red Wolf 及其教派，是为了她的儿子 North——希望帮助教派实现一个更平等的世界。
facts.anchor: She’d done it for her son, North, hoping to help the cult bring about a more equal world.

facts.fact: Dautre 已把这份情报转交给 Silver 与 Argent——精灵的 King and Queen of Swords。
facts.anchor: Dautre had passed on the intel to Silver and Argent, the King and Queen of Swords

facts.fact: Adam 说被那东西袭击的人当中有些还活着，但他们的灵魂失踪了。
facts.anchor: Some of the people it attacked are alive, but their spirits are missing.
